command: for d in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/qcom,dsi-display-primary /sys/class/drm/card0-DSI-1 /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/pinctrl@f000000; do echo "NODE $d"; ls "$d"; done; for f in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/qcom,dsi-display-primary/*; do test -f "$f" || continue; echo "PROP $f"; od -An -v -tx1 "$f"; done; find /sys/firmware/devicetree/base -type d | grep -Ei "m2.*(dsi|panel)|dsi.*m2|pinctrl@f000000"
